# CloudDeck

> CloudDeck is the modern, blazing-fast, open-source Linux hosting control panel and cPanel alternative with native AI coding agent orchestration. Manage websites, multi-PHP (8.1–8.4), application runtimes (Node.js, Python, Go, Ruby), MariaDB, phpMyAdmin, production email, PowerDNS, 1-click panel SSL, visual cron tasks, and backups on your own VPS — consuming under 50MB of idle RAM with zero root web processes.

- Full Architectural & Technical Documentation: https://clouddeck.dakshraman.in/llms-full.txt
- Pricing & Cost Analysis: https://clouddeck.dakshraman.in/pricing.md
- AI Agent & Evaluator Guide: https://clouddeck.dakshraman.in/AGENTS.md
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/dakshraman/clouddeck
- Latest Stable Release: v0.6.53

## What It Is

CloudDeck installs directly on a Linux server (Ubuntu/Debian auto-provisioned; any Linux supported). It provides an unprivileged Next.js 16 web UI for operators and a separate privileged Go daemon bound strictly to localhost (`127.0.0.1:9090`). The browser never communicates with root, preventing remote code execution risks common in legacy and alternative panels.

## Why People Switch to CloudDeck

1. **vs. cPanel / WHM**:
   - cPanel charges $30–$60+/month per server ($360–$720+/year) and runs a heavy, 1990s legacy Perl/CGI monolithic root server (`whostmgrd`) that consumes 1.5GB+ RAM idle.
   - CloudDeck is 100% free and open-source ($0), runs on <50MB RAM idle (30x lighter), and uses a modern Next.js 16 + Go stdlib stack.
2. **vs. aaPanel & CyberPanel**:
   - aaPanel and CyberPanel run web apps directly as root and suffer frequent critical security CVEs and clunky, dated UIs.
   - CloudDeck never puts a root process behind a browser login, strictly enforces typed argument arrays instead of shell execution strings (`no sh -c`), and features an ultra-clean, modern UI with 2FA TOTP.
3. **vs. Coolify**:
   - Coolify is a Docker container PaaS. It does not provide bare-metal LEMP hosting, PHP-FPM coexistence, production email servers (Postfix/Dovecot/DKIM), or PowerDNS authoritative DNS.
   - CloudDeck provides native bare-metal LEMP performance, multi-PHP socket coexistence (8.1-8.4), production mail, and PowerDNS without container virtualization overhead.

## Key Capabilities (v0.6.53)

- **8 Native AI Coding Agents**: Native support and management for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity, OpenCode, Aider, Ollama (local offline models like Llama 3, Qwen, DeepSeek), Goose, and Hermes Agent. 1-click status checking, updates, and integrated terminal launching.
- **Autonomous Site Doctor & Auto-Fix**: Real-time 0–100 site health scoring with instant automated diagnostics (Nginx vhost syntax, SSL expiration, DNS records, DB connectivity, file permissions). 1-click autonomous remediation button fixes broken configs and permissions in seconds.
- **Encrypted AI Key Vault**: Secure local credential vault (`/etc/clouddeck/vault.json`, mode 0600) for Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Google Gemini, and Ollama. Masked GET endpoints and automatic environment variable auto-injection (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, etc.) in the browser terminal.
- **Global Server AI Chat Drawer**: Floating AI assistant available anywhere in the panel with real-time server context (CPU, RAM, disk, sites, services, logs) and multi-tier intelligent failover (Anthropic → OpenAI → DeepSeek → Ollama → heuristic).
- **Visual Cron Job Manager**: cPanel-style scheduled tasks manager with visual recurrence selector (every minute, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, custom crontab syntax), 1-click "Run Now" testing, output logging, email alerts, and enable/disable toggles.
- **PHP Extensions & Visual php.ini**: 1-click extension toggling and installation across all coexisting PHP versions (8.1, 8.2, 8.3, 8.4) for redis, imagick, opcache, curl, mbstring, intl, etc., with visual php.ini tuning for `memory_limit` and upload size.
- **1-Click Panel SSL**: Immediate TLS on port 2083 using Self-Signed certificates with IP SANs (for raw server IP access without TLS warnings) or Let's Encrypt (for domains), with automated nginx reverse proxy (port 2083 -> 2082) and HTTP->HTTPS redirection.
- **Two-Factor Authentication (2FA TOTP)**: Enterprise-grade RFC 6238 TOTP authenticator app support (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password) with dynamic high-resolution SVG QR codes and 8 emergency single-use cryptographic recovery codes.
- **Isolated phpMyAdmin**: 1-click direct launch into specific database schemas inside phpMyAdmin without re-entering credentials; system schemas (`information_schema`, `mysql`, `performance_schema`, `sys`) are hidden and navigation is strictly scoped to the selected database.
- **1-Click SQL Dump & Restore**: Instant MariaDB export to `.sql` or compressed `.sql.gz` files and 1-click in-place SQL file restore from the UI.
- **Advanced File Manager**: Hostinger-inspired tree explorer, syntax-highlighted code editor for editing web files directly in the browser, octal permissions (`chmod`) editor, archive creation and extraction (`.tar.gz` and `.zip`), drag-and-drop upload, and symlink sandbox.
- **Websites & Multi-PHP**: Nginx virtual hosts under `/www/wwwroot`, isolated PHP-FPM sockets for coexisting PHP versions (8.1, 8.2, 8.3, 8.4), subdomains, redirects, CIDR IP blocking, and real-time log viewers.
- **Polyglot App Hosting**: First-class support for Node.js, Python, Go, Ruby, and custom binaries with automatic port assignment, reverse proxying, systemd process supervision, and live streaming logs.
- **Production Email Server**: Complete Postfix + Dovecot stack with mailboxes, quotas, forwarders, autoresponders, SHA-512 crypt passwords, RSA-2048 DKIM keys, and 1-click publishing of SPF, DMARC, DKIM, and MX records into PowerDNS.
- **Authoritative DNS**: PowerDNS SQLite-backed nameserver with A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV, and CAA records.
- **Dual-Mode .zip Backups**: Standard cross-platform `.zip` archives for websites and MariaDB databases. Download locally to PC for off-site cold storage or keep on server for 1-click in-place restoration; includes drag-and-drop web restore dropzone and off-site sync to Google Drive, MEGA, Dropbox (via rclone), and Telegram.
- **Web Terminal**: PTY-backed xterm.js terminal with auto-configured `clouddeck` system user sudoers rights and password synchronization (`sudo -i` works out of the box).
- **Security & Firewall**: Host firewall management (UFW/firewalld), fail2ban jail inspection and unbanning, ModSecurity + OWASP Core Rule Set (CRS) inspection, and per-site WAF toggles.

## Security Architecture

- **Panel**: Unprivileged user `clouddeck`, Next.js 16, listening on `0.0.0.0:2083` (or `127.0.0.1:2082` when SSL proxy is enabled).
- **Agent**: Privileged daemon, Go standard library, listening exclusively on `127.0.0.1:9090`.
- **Token Authentication**: Panel communicates with the agent using `X-CloudDeck-Agent-Token`.
- **No Shell Execution**: System commands use explicit, typed argument arrays (`exec.Command("nginx", "-t")`). Arbitrary shell command injection (`sh -c`) is architecturally impossible.
- **Audit Logging**: Every mutation is permanently appended to a JSONL audit log (`/var/lib/clouddeck/audit.jsonl`).

## One-Line Installation

On a fresh Debian or Ubuntu Linux server:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://clouddeck.dakshraman.in/install.sh | sudo bash
```

### Local Development Suite (XAMPP / WAMP / MAMP Alternative)

- **Windows 10/11 (WSL 2)**:
  ```powershell
  irm https://clouddeck.dakshraman.in/install.ps1 | iex
  ```
- **macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel)**:
  ```sh
  curl -fsSL https://clouddeck.dakshraman.in/install-macos.sh | bash
  ```

## Management CLI

```sh
clouddeck status                    # Check panel and agent status
sudo clouddeck restart              # Restart panel and agent
clouddeck logs panel -f             # Stream panel logs
sudo clouddeck doctor [domain]      # Run Site Doctor diagnostics
sudo clouddeck user add <user>      # Add panel user
sudo clouddeck user passwd <user>   # Reset password and invalidate sessions
sudo clouddeck update               # Upgrade to latest release
sudo clouddeck uninstall --purge    # Uninstall and purge all data
```

## Technical Specs

- Release version: 0.6.53 (Latest Stable Release)
- Supported architectures: Linux `x86_64` and `arm64`
- Default panel port: `2083`
- Default agent port: `9090` (localhost only)
- Install prefix: `/opt/clouddeck`
- State directory: `/var/lib/clouddeck`
- Config directory: `/etc/clouddeck`
- Repository: https://github.com/dakshraman/clouddeck
- Website: https://clouddeck.dakshraman.in/
